title: plugintype
description: Note Single-valued navigation properties (bind with <name>@odata.bind, expand with $expand): createdby, createdonbehalfby, modifiedby, modifiedonbehalfby, organizationid, pluginassemblyid.

assemblyname.description: Full path name of the plug-in assembly.

createdon.description: Date and time when the plug-in type was created.

culture.description: Culture code for the plug-in assembly.

customizationlevel.description: Customization level of the plug-in type.

customworkflowactivityinfo.description: Serialized Custom Activity Type information, including required arguments.

friendlyname.description: User friendly name for the plug-in.

isworkflowactivity.description: Indicates if the plug-in is a custom activity for workflows.

major.description: Major of the version number of the assembly for the plug-in type.

minor.description: Minor of the version number of the assembly for the plug-in type.

modifiedon.description: Date and time when the plug-in type was last modified.

plugintypeexportkey.description: Uniquely identifies the plug-in type associated with a plugin package when exporting a solution.

plugintypeid.description: Unique identifier of the plug-in type.

plugintypeidunique.description: Unique identifier of the plug-in type.

publickeytoken.description: Public key token of the assembly for the plug-in type.

solutionid.description: Unique identifier of the associated solution.

typename.description: Fully qualified type name of the plug-in type.

version.description: Version number of the assembly for the plug-in type.

workflowactivitygroupname.description: Group name of workflow custom activity.

_createdby_value.description: Unique identifier of the user who created the plug-in type.

_createdonbehalfby_value.description: Unique identifier of the delegate user who created the plugintype.

_modifiedby_value.description: Unique identifier of the user who last modified the plug-in type.

_modifiedonbehalfby_value.description: Unique identifier of the delegate user who last modified the plugintype.

_organizationid_value.description: Unique identifier of the organization with which the plug-in type is associated.

_pluginassemblyid_value.description: Unique identifier of the plug-in assembly that contains this plug-in type.
